Fix misleading add command preamble error (#298)
commitResults.messageBody:
When the user typed 'add sad n/sad p/88888888 e/sad@gmail.com a/sad',
the parser rejected the command with 'Missing required parameters',
which is misleading — the prefixes are all present but there is an
extra preamble ('sad') before them.

Throw the standard MESSAGE_INVALID_COMMAND_FORMAT with the usage
string instead, matching the convention used by other parsers
(ShowCommandParser, TagPoolCommandParser, etc.). The genuine
'no parameters at all' path still uses MESSAGE_MISSING_ALL.

commitResults.messageTitle: Person: Add status and rejection tracking fields
commitResults.messageBody:
Person model currently has no way to track candidate
rejection status or store rejection history.

The upcoming reject command requires a status field and
a chronological list of rejection reasons on each Person.

Let's add a Status enum (NONE, REJECTED, ARCHIVED),
a RejectionReason value object with validation, and
extend Person with these new fields. The JSON storage
layer, EditCommand, and test utilities are updated to
preserve backward compatibility by defaulting to
Status.NONE with an empty rejection list.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>

There is currently no way to mark a candidate as rejected
or record why they were rejected.

Recruiters need to reject candidates with a reason so
that rejection history is preserved for future reference.

Let's add a RejectCommand that takes an index and a
reason (r/ prefix), validates the input, checks for
archived status, and creates a new Person with REJECTED
status and the reason appended to the rejection history.
Sequential duplicate reasons trigger a warning message.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>

The new RejectCommand and RejectCommandParser lack test
coverage, and AddressBookParserTest does not verify that
the reject command is wired correctly.

Let's add RejectCommandTest covering valid/invalid index
on filtered and unfiltered lists, archived candidate
rejection, multiple rejections, sequential duplicate
warning, and status change verification. Add
RejectCommandParserTest for format validation, boundary
cases, and special character handling. Add
RejectionReasonTest for value object validation. Update
AddressBookParserTest with reject command routing test.

FindCommand only searches the candidate's name and requires an exact
full-word match.

Recruiters need a fast, forgiving search to retrieve records quickly
using fragments of info during high-pressure calls.

Let's:
* update the search algorithm to use case-insensitive substring
  matching across Name, Phone, and Email fields
* enforce MVP constraints like 150 characters max, 20 keywords max,
  and valid symbol limits
* update display messages to accurately reflect the filtered results

This provides the core candidate look-up capability. Replacing
NameContainsKeywordsPredicate with an expanded
NamePhoneEmailContainsKeywordsPredicate accurately reflects the new
multi-field search dimensions without disrupting existing architecture.

commitResults.messageTitle: Update Domain constraints and test suites
commitResults.messageBody:
There are new validation constraints required for candidate
details editing in Talently.

Updating the validation regex rules and tests for Name,
Phone, and Email improves the reliability of the system.

As a step towards implementing the EditCommand, let's update
the Domain classes (Name, Phone, Email, Person) and tests to
enforce these new strict constraints. Doing so will make the
subsequent command logic easier to implement.

Allow a recruiter to update a candidate’s stored contact information
when new or corrected details are obtained.

Command Format: edit INDEX [n/NAME] [p/PHONE] [e/EMAIL]
(At least one field must be specified).

Parameters & Validation:
INDEX: Must be a positive integer corresponding to a valid index
in the currently displayed list. No leading zeros.
Trimmed of whitespace.

NAME (n/): 1-100 chars. Allowed: letters (A-Z, a-z), spaces,
hyphens (-), apostrophes ('), periods (.), and slashes (/).
Case-sensitive for storage, case-insensitive for duplicate
checking. Collapse multiple consecutive spaces into a single
space during storage. Trim whitespace from start/end.

PHONE (p/): 3-15 chars. Allowed: digits (0-9). Optional
'+' allowed ONLY as the first character. Trim whitespace.

EMAIL (e/): Max length 254 chars. Standard AB3 format.
Case-insensitive for storage and duplicate checking.
Trim whitespace.
